## Purpose

Single source of truth for "what runs and when" on Pro. Replaces ad-hoc
tribal knowledge with a programmatically-regeneratable artifact. Future
audits should rerun `python scripts/audit/dump_launchagents.py` and diff.

## Method

All data extracted from `~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.balizero.*.plist`
via `plistlib` and cross-referenced with `launchctl print` for live
state. Disabled plists (`.disabled-*`, `.backup-*`) are skipped.

Regenerate:

```bash
python scripts/audit/dump_launchagents.py --filter wr2
python scripts/audit/dump_launchagents.py --filter intel
python scripts/audit/dump_launchagents.py  # all 79 com.balizero.* plists
```

## Filename-vs-Label mismatches (cosmetic, OK as-is)

Some plists have filename suffix (`.10min`, `.daily`, `.hourly`, `.weekly`,
`.monthly`, `.minute`) NOT present in the internal `<key>Label</key>`. This
is intentional — filename indicates schedule, label is short. `launchctl
print` requires the SHORT label form. Discovered Phase A.3 (2026-05-20).

## Maintenance

When adding a new plist:

1. Use `com.balizero.<family>.<name>[.<schedule-hint>]` naming
2. Set internal `Label` to the SHORT form (without schedule-hint suffix)
3. Regenerate this doc: `python scripts/audit/dump_launchagents.py > snapshot.md`
4. Commit BOTH the plist install and the snapshot diff

When decommissioning a plist (per cicatrix 2026-05-13):

1. `launchctl bootout gui/$UID/<label>`
2. Move file: `mv plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/.disabled-YYYY-MM-DD/`
3. NEVER leave disabled plists in the active dir (sibling-agent resurrection risk)
